scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.assumptions: Advanced-substrate demand grows but pricing pressure resumes and Cell 8 loading slips; FY3/28 revenue JPY620bn, OP JPY145bn, net profit JPY96bn; 30x P/E, the low end of the band because earnings quality is being questioned.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.assumptions: Cell 8 ramps from FY2027, high-end substrate supply stays tight, the ~JPY10bn price-decline buffer partly reverses; FY3/28 revenue JPY660bn, OP JPY180bn, net profit JPY120bn; 36x P/E, in line with the market's structural-growth and Neutral/Hold view.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.assumptions: Stronger AI GPU/ASIC and server-CPU mix, faster Cell 8 loading and better pricing; FY3/28 revenue JPY690bn, OP JPY205bn, net profit JPY130bn; 34x P/E — the multiple compresses as earnings approach peak-cycle levels.

valuation.method_note: Fair-value band is 30-50x P/E, applied to FY3/27 EPS of about JPY157 (net profit JPY89.0bn / 566.3m shares), giving roughly JPY4,715-7,858. The band spans a cyclical-low multiple of 30x and a peak-growth multiple of 50x (the substrate shortage justifies above-market multiples, while cyclicality justifies the low end). Scenarios price FY3/28 EPS: Bear 169.5 x 30 = 5,085; Base 211.9 x 36 = 7,628; Bull 229.6 x 34 = 7,806 — all three targets fall inside the declared band, and every scenario multiple is inside 30-50x.

warnings: Documents label the year ending March 2027 as FY2026; the model maps it to FY3/27 under the issuer's March fiscal calendar and uses FY3/28 and FY3/29 for the following two years.

FY3/26 actuals are the data-vendor annual figures because the documents give H1 FY3/27 and prior H1 but not full FY3/26; FY3/26 ordinary profit is null because it is not disclosed in the annual facts.
Q1 FY3/27 actual is revenue JPY123.2bn, OP JPY26.9bn and net profit JPY17.9bn; Q2 FY3/27 is derived as H1 actual JPY262.5bn/60.1bn/38.6bn less Q1.
H2 FY3/27 is split Q3/Q4 48/52 for revenue, OP and net profit, based on recent Q4-over-Q3 seasonality; this is an assumption.
FY3/27 forecast coincides with management guidance because it is built as H1 actual plus H2 guided figures; there was no independent H2 adjustment.

Our FY3/28 OP forecast of JPY180bn is above management's JPY165bn target but below the Citi-cited JPY190bn consensus because we reverse about JPY10bn of embedded price-decline conservatism and add a measured Cell 8 ramp net of start-up costs.
FY3/29 is not a company target; it is interpolated toward the FY3/31 (company FY2030) JPY1tn sales / JPY300bn+ OP ambition and excludes Cell 6 contribution, which starts company FY2029 (FY3/30).
The JPY151bn Cell 6 investment is not included in FY3/29 revenue; operation starts company FY2029 (FY3/30), with revenue contribution later.
FY3/27 segment figures are estimates and sum to group revenue JPY565bn and OP JPY133bn; Electronics FY3/27 OP is anchored on H1 Electronics OP of JPY50.0bn at a 29.0% margin.
Capex of JPY200bn for FY3/27 is confirmed in the call despite being about 35% of sales, so it is not treated as a unit error.
Share count of 566.3m is derived from FY3/27 guidance net profit JPY89.0bn divided by EPS JPY157.17 and is used as a proxy for market-cap shares; issued-minus-treasury shares may differ.
Payout ratio uses the FY3/27 forecast annual dividend of JPY20 per share after stock splits divided by EPS JPY157.17.
Consensus carries only the Citi-cited FY3/28 OP estimate of JPY190bn; revenue, net profit and EPS are null because no document states them.
The valuation uses the instructed share price of JPY8,045, not the JPY8,359 reference price in the broker report.
The Bull scenario carries a lower multiple (34x) than the Base (36x) because peak-cycle earnings are discounted, which keeps every scenario target inside the declared fair-value band.
Quarterly plan has no H1 guidance row: H1 rebuilt from reported Q1 FY3/27 + Q2 FY3/27, so the Q2 line is definitional; H2 = FY3/27 guidance - H1 still checks the reported Q3/Q4.
FY3/27 capex is 35% of revenue; check the unit (a Japanese filing's 億円 is 0.1bn, not 1bn).
